name: Clickbait Thumbnail
summary: A small still that must win a click at 168px wide. It has a huge face with an open mouth, a red arrow or circle, bright colours and 1 to 3 words in a thick outline.

philosophy.core_thesis: The still has one second to ask a question: show one clear shock, one object and 3 words, and make it readable at the size of a thumb.
design_principles: Make the image 1280x720 and test it at 168px wide before you ship it.
Fill 40% to 60% of the frame with one face at a strong expression, cut out with a 6px white edge.
Use at most 3 words in a thick display face of 120px to 200px with a 8px black outline.
Draw one arrow or circle in red (#FF0000) or yellow (#FFE500) to point at the key object.
Push saturation by 20% to 40% and add a 12% vignette to the edge.
Split the frame into 2 halves (before and after, or A and B) with a diagonal line of 8px.
Keep all text and faces 48px away from the lower-right corner, where the duration badge sits.
anti_patterns: Calm, subtle colour and soft grading
Long titles of 6 words or more
Small faces and wide, empty scenes
Many small objects with no single focus

layout.grid_mechanics: A 1280x720 frame split by a rule-of-thirds layout: the face on the left or right third, the object on the other third, the words across the top or bottom.
layout.whitespace_ratio: Under 8% of the frame is empty; every area carries a face, an object or a word.
layout.alignment_rules: The face is large and off-centre; the arrow runs from the face towards the object; words align to one edge.
layout.container_geometry: Cut-out shapes with a 6px white edge; a 0px frame with no radius; circles and arrows as pointers.

font_pairings.note: Anton is an open look-alike of the Impact face that thumbnails use.
A tall, capital face for 2-word titles.
A thick, friendly face for jokes and challenge titles.

typography.tracking: Display takes 0em to +0.02em; text lines stay tight.
hierarchy_rules: Use one display weight (400 or 900) for all words.
Use sizes 120, 160 and 200px in the frame and 18px on a page.
Set the first word in white and the key word in yellow.
Add an outline of 8px in black to each word.

color.palette_structure: Pure, saturated primaries on a split ground: red, yellow and electric blue, with black outlines and white edges.
color.contrast_rules: White text on the black surface holds at least 18:1; on the blue ground it holds at least 5:1 with an 8px black outline.
color.surface_treatment: A flat colour or a 2-stop gradient, a 12% vignette and a 20% to 40% boost of saturation.
color.light_and_shadow: A white rim light on the cut-out face, a 12px black drop shadow at 60% under words and a soft glow of 20px behind the object.

materiality.surface_simulation: A compressed digital still: a sharp photo cut-out, a hard edge and a heavy colour boost.
materiality.border_rules: A 6px white edge on cut-outs and an 8px black outline on text.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Hard 12px drop shadows; a 20px glow behind the main object; the ground may blur at 8px.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid arrows, circles and question marks in red or yellow at 80px to 160px; thick strokes of 8px.
ornamentation_details.illustration: A face cut-out, one product or one stunt object, and a bold shape; no clean line art.

motion.transition_physics: A still has no motion; on a page the card scales to 105% over 150ms on hover and the arrow wobbles by 6° over 600ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover scales the thumbnail to 105% and adds a 4px yellow edge; active state scales to 98%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a spike of curiosity, shock or doubt and wants to see what happens.

use_cases: ad creatives that need a fast hook
avoid_when: The brand needs a quiet or trusted tone.
The content cannot pay off the promise of the image.
The audience is professional or medical.

modifiers.how: Use one still frame, one title line of 48px and a muted grade with no arrow.
Show the real product on a plain table with a short label and no face.
Replace the arrow with a caption of 4 words and a highlighted key word.

pack.why: A heavy, solid family matches the thick arrows and circles of a thumbnail.

ground.why: The ground is a burst of rays behind the face, the oldest way to pull the eye to one point.
